model.activity

Class FeedingActivity

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.activity.Activity
      • model.activity.FeedingActivity

  • public class FeedingActivity
extends Activity
    Represents a feeding activity for a specific animal in a habitat. This class extends the `Activity` class and includes additional attributes specific to feeding activities, such as the animal being fed, its diet type, and the weight of the food.

      • FeedingActivity

        public FeedingActivity(java.lang.String id,
                       Habitat habitat,
                       Employee responsible,
                       java.time.LocalDate schedulingDate,
                       Animal animal,
                       double weight)
        Constructs a FeedingActivity object with the specified attributes.
        Parameters:
        id - The unique identifier of the activity. Must not be null or empty.
        habitat - The habitat associated with the activity. Must not be null.
        responsible - The employee responsible for the activity. Must not be null.
        schedulingDate - The date the activity is scheduled for. Must not be null.
        animal - The animal being fed. Must not be null.
        weight - The weight of the food to be provided. Must be greater than 0.

        Parameters:
